resources.string:
The system switch is on, but Suflyor is not connected.

Tap Repair, turn the Suflyor accessibility switch off, wait two seconds and turn it on again. Return here to check the connection.

If this keeps happening, see the background settings in recording setup.
The accessibility service is off. Voice prompting over another recording app may not work.\n\nTap Enable, find Suflyor, turn on its accessibility switch and return to the app.

If the service often stops, allow background activity, choose unrestricted battery usage and check for an auto-start option in system settings. Names differ by device. These settings can reduce restrictions but cannot guarantee the service stays alive.
Cannot open system settings. Open them manually on your phone.
Accessibility is disconnected. Voice prompting over other apps may fail. Tap to open the app and repair it.
